runner.compiler: t27c gen-c (t27 90fc25b3b), cc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, flags -O2 with fp contraction off

x_extension.driver: t27c gen-c specs/benchmarks/gf16_bfloat16_nmse_run.t27, then the lefthook.yml one-line C main: stdin to nmse_manifest, result to stdout
x_extension.stream: one xoshiro256pp stream seeded by splitmix64(seed); D_NORM, D_LOG, D_RELU, D_PHI, D_DEEP drawn in that order, samples_per_distribution each
x_extension.normal_sampler: Box-Muller on 53-bit uniforms, both values of a pair used
x_extension.d_phi_reading: N(mean, variance): mean phi, standard deviation sqrt(1/phi)
x_extension.d_deep_reading: per sample: D_NORM with probability 0.7, else D_LOG
x_extension.rounding: both formats round to nearest, ties to even, once from f64; the frozen GF16 SSOT encoder rounds ties toward zero, which differs from this only on the samples counted in gf16_ties
x_extension.gf16_range: FORMAT-SPEC-001 GF16, no subnormals: |x| < 2^-31 and values rounding to 2^-31 flush to signed zero; E = 63 is Inf
x_extension.accumulation: Neumaier-compensated f64 sums; nmse = sum (x - Q(x))^2 / sum x^2
x_extension.number_text: ten significant digits, the last within one unit
